title: A Love Yet to Bloom

synopsis: Takamine, a girl who can’t seem to find something she likes or even really enjoys, has a chance encounter with Sakura, a student from a different school. A sweet, slow burn romance about two young women and the relationship that blossoms between them. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
